name: Staff of Tricks
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 203
Aura moderate illusion CL 8th
Slot none; Price 8,800 gp; Weight 3 lbs.
Description
This thin staff is made of stiff wood that has been wrapped in colorful bands of cloth and topped with a number of feathers, bells, and other decorative baubles. The staff allows use of the following spells:
Ghost sound (1 charge)
Mage hand (1 charge)
Prestidigitation (1 charge)
Silent image (2 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, ghost sound, mage hand, prestidigitation, silent image; Cost 4,400 gp
